video_title: Amy E Peters x Sandberg Wallpaper paid partnership post
evidence: CollabFeed's public paid-partnership feed identified an Instagram collaboration between Canadian home/interior creator @amyepeters and Sandberg Wallpaper posted August 27, 2026.
